entries.title: Terraform cannot reach the state lock database
entries.root_cause: The DynamoDB endpoint configured for state locking refuses connections, preventing Terraform from acquiring the production state lock. The backend endpoint must be corrected or made reachable.

entries.title: State lock database endpoint still unreachable
entries.root_cause: The DynamoDB endpoint configured for state locking refuses connections, preventing Terraform from acquiring the production state lock. The backend endpoint must be corrected or made reachable.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request runs a plan with different inputs, Terraform version and lock timeout, but the same backend endpoint refuses connections.

entries.title: GitHub provider cannot update repository file
entries.root_cause: The workflow's GitHub token has read-only contents permission, so the GitHub provider cannot update a repository file. The workflow must grant contents write permission.

entries.title: AWS provider version unavailable
entries.root_cause: The configuration constrains the AWS provider to a version that is not published in the Terraform registry. The provider version constraint must be corrected.
